annotations.title: Show SAP MCP Profile Agent Public Key

description:
Return the configured public agent key for a profile without reading or exposing keypair bytes.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Show SAP MCP Profile Agent Public Key input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

profileName.description: Profile name. Defaults to the loaded profile.

name: sap_profile_public_key

content.description: MCP content blocks returned to the caller.

text.description: Human-readable JSON or text returned by the tool.

type.description: MCP content block type, usually text.

isError.description: True when the tool result represents an application-level error.
